ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query asks for a concise factual/illustrative answer with an explicit brevity and instruction-following constraint ("don't ramble, just answer"). Plover leads on instruction-following (IFEval 90.4 vs 85.6) and reliably tracks such constraints, and it outperforms Curlew across the relevant internal evals (Summarization, Support Dialogue, Extraction). The task isn't unconstrained creative invention—so Plover's stated aversion to open-ended generative work doesn't penalize it here. Curlew's only edge is harm-adjacent content, which isn't relevant to this benign request.
